clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: George and I had big arguments about the MacGuffin. … But I am loyal to my best friend. When he writes a story he believes in—even if I don't believe in it—I'm going to shoot the movie the way George envisioned it.
clippings.film: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
clippings.title: Steven Spielberg says you should blame George Lucas for that last Indiana Jones movie
clippings.context: Spielberg told Empire magazine in 2011 that he and Lucas argued over the crystal skull MacGuffin, as reported by The A.V. Club; the original Empire article was not readable (paywalled).

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: When the phone rang and he found out that every single 10:30 a.m. show throughout the entire nation had been sold out, George became euphoric, to say the least, and, in his euphoria, immediately began thinking about the future. … And George said I've got something better than James Bond, it's called Raiders of the Lost Ark.
clippings.title: Age & Innocence
clippings.context: Spielberg recalls the 1977 Hawaii beach conversation after Star Wars opened, when Lucas pitched what became Raiders, in a DGA Quarterly interview (Winter 2006 issue).

notes: Only two quotes, both Spielberg about Lucas; no Lucas-about-Spielberg quote could be verified. The Empire Raiders oral history returned HTTP 402 (paywalled). The 1977 LA Times repost has only 'It turned out real well. I liked it' (generic, so skipped). Famous lines (Duel 'really sharp', 'best boss I ever had') appear only in unsourced secondary pages, so skipped. The Empire article date is not confirmed; date uses the year only.
